name: Additive Manufacturing of Materials
summary: Covers 3D printing of metals, polymers, ceramics and composites, with focus on process-structure-property relationships and qualification.

topics.name: The seven ASTM/ISO additive manufacturing process categories
Polymer AM: material extrusion (FDM), vat photopolymerisation (SLA/DLP) and powder bed fusion (SLS)
Metal laser and electron-beam powder bed fusion
Directed energy deposition and wire-arc AM
Binder jetting and sintering; metal material extrusion
Melt-pool physics: keyholing, balling and spatter
Rapid solidification microstructures, texture and anisotropy in AM metals
Defects: lack-of-fusion and gas porosity, residual stress and cracking
Post-processing: HIP, heat treatment, machining and surface finishing
Alloys designed for AM (e.g. printable high-strength aluminium)
Ceramic and composite AM; continuous-fibre printing
Design for AM: lattices, topology optimisation and part consolidation
In-situ monitoring, qualification and certification of AM parts (e.g. rocket engine components)
